title: deployment-version v0.1.0
description: Manifest schema for HTTP-served deployments exposing deploy/build version information. Conforming servers publish a manifest at /.well-known/deployment-version.json and MAY emit a Deployment-Version response header; HTML responses MAY include a <meta name="deployment-version"> tag. Narrative at https://ben.abbitt.me/posts/deployment-version/.

version.description: Semver 2.0.0 version of the deployment-version spec this manifest conforms to. The pattern is the official semver 2.0.0 regex.

url.description: Canonical versioned URL of the deployment-version spec the manifest conforms to.

elements.description: Components of the deployment, each with an independent version. MAY be empty.

links.description: OPTIONAL. Outbound links to related resources on this host, in RFC 8288 web-linking style. If the host publishes an api-catalog per RFC 9727, this array SHOULD include a link with rel='api-catalog' pointing to it.

rel.description: RFC 8288 link relation type. RECOMMENDED to use an IANA-registered name from the link relation registry, or an extension URI.

type.description: OPTIONAL. Media type of the linked resource (RFC 8288 type parameter).

title.description: OPTIONAL. Human-readable title for the link (RFC 8288 title parameter).

id.description: OPTIONAL. Stable, lowercase-kebab-case identifier addressable as a URL fragment on the manifest URL (e.g. '#forage-atlas'). MUST be unique across all elements in the manifest, including elements nested at any depth. RECOMMENDED for any element that may be cross-referenced from other resources (such as an api-catalog entry). Uniqueness is not enforced by this JSON Schema and is the publisher's responsibility.

path.description: URL path scoping this element. SHOULD start with '/'. The root element uses '/'.

text.description: REQUIRED. The canonical or display form of this element's version. RECOMMENDED to be the form a human reading the manifest would recognize (e.g. '1.2.3', '2026.05.20', '9063c2a', 'v1.2.3+build.456').

scheme.description: OPTIONAL. Identifier naming the versioning scheme AND the version of that scheme's interpretation, in 'name@version' form (e.g. 'semver@2.0.0', 'git-sha@1.0.0'). SHOULD be a registered entry from the well-known scheme registry maintained in the spec narrative. MAY be a custom name, in which case the name SHOULD be prefixed with the publisher's organization (e.g. 'acme.rolling-calver@1.0.0'). MAY be null to explicitly assert that no scheme applies; this is distinct from omitting the field, which is silence.

parts.description: OPTIONAL. Implementation-defined parsed structure, typically corresponding to 'scheme'. The shape is not constrained by this spec; common conventions documented in the narrative include semver (major, minor, patch, prerelease, build), CalVer (year, month, day), and Git build metadata (commit, branch). The canonical version remains the 'text' field; consumers MUST NOT assume any particular shape of 'parts'.

elements.description: OPTIONAL nested elements. A child's path SHOULD be a descendant of the parent's path. Producers MAY use either a flat or nested form; consumers MUST handle both.
